Mystery Saja

Korean: 미스터리 사자

Group (2025-present):
Saja Boys

Introduction

Mystery Saja is a fictional singer from the 2025 Netflix film Kpop Demon Hunters. He serves as the sub-vocal and visual enigma of the fictional boy group Saja Boys. Mystery is voiced by Alan Lee, a Korean American voice actor known for works such as The Ghost and The Ghost and Molly McGee, while his singing voice is provided by Kevin Woo, a member of U-KISS and solo artist.

Inspired by anime archetypes and the idea of faceless idols, Mystery is designed as the unreadable cipher of the group. With his long, violet hair concealing most of his expression, he embodies elegance and eeriness in equal measure. Director Kang explained that Mystery's concept came partly from animation limitations, but fans quickly turned him into their projection point. As the group's most enigmatic figure, Mystery represents the unknowable presence, unsettling yet gentle, elusive yet magnetic.
